```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```
problem1
```{r}

nyc_transit <- read_csv("data/NYC_Transit_Subway_Entrance_And_Exit_Data.csv", na = c("NA", "", "."))



dim(nyc_transit)


nyc_clean <- nyc_transit |> 
  rename_with(~ str_replace_all(tolower(.), " ", "_")) |> 
  select(
    line,
    station_name,
    station_latitude,
    station_longitude,
    starts_with("route"), 
    entrance_type,
    entry,
    vending,
    ada
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    
    entry = case_match(
      entry,
      "YES" ~ TRUE,
      "NO" ~ FALSE,
      .default = NA
    ),
 
    across(starts_with("route"), as.character)
  )



dim(nyc_clean)
print("Entry variable conversion check:")
table(nyc_clean$entry, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}

distinct_stations <- nyc_clean |> 
  distinct(station_name, line) |> 
  nrow()
print(paste("1. Number of distinct stations:", distinct_stations))

ada_stations <- nyc_clean |> 
  filter(ada == TRUE) |> 
  distinct(station_name, line) |> 
  nrow()
print(paste("2. Number of ADA compliant stations:", ada_stations))


total_no_vending <- nyc_clean |> 
  filter(vending == "NO") |> 
  nrow()
print(paste("   Total entrances without vending (denominator):", total_no_vending))

no_vending_entry <- nyc_clean |> 
  filter(vending == "NO", entry == TRUE) |> 
  nrow()
print(paste("   Entrances without vending that allow entry (numerator):", no_vending_entry))

proportion_no_vending <- no_vending_entry / total_no_vending
print(paste("3. Proportion:", round(proportion_no_vending, 4)))

```

```{r}

nyc_long <- nyc_clean |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("route"),
    names_to = "route_number",
    values_to = "route",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |> 
  mutate(route = str_trim(route))



dim(nyc_long)


a_train_stations <- nyc_long |> 
  filter(route == "A") |> 
  distinct(station_name, line) |> 
  nrow()
print(paste("4. Number of distinct stations served by A train:", a_train_stations))


a_train_ada <- nyc_long |> 
  filter(route == "A", ada == TRUE) |> 
  distinct(station_name, line) |> 
  nrow()
print(paste("5. A train stations that are ADA compliant:", a_train_ada))
```

read and clean data
```{r}
# Problem 2


mr_trash_wheel =
  readxl::read_excel(
    "data/202610 Trash Wheel Collection Data.xlsx",
    sheet = "Mr. Trash Wheel",
    range = "A2:N1000"
  ) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  drop_na(dumpster) |>
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year),
    month = str_trim(month),
    sports_balls = as.integer(round(sports_balls)),
    trash_wheel = "Mr. Trash Wheel"
  )

```
